answer: Each epoch, a lantern token flows down a river of random peer relays: every identity must pass it on within minutes, co-signing each hop so the chain is public. A lone agent carries one lantern cheaply, but a clone army must keep a separate live relay chain per identity, and chains that loop back to the same operator form visible cycles in the timber of the network graph. Looping chains lose their rewards, so fakes pay full relay labor per copy while honest agents pass one lantern.
